name: attribution-untrusted-basemap
_comment: Hermetic basemap whose source attribution carries markup other than a plain link (an element with a src, an element with a data attribute, a link with an extra attribute). A document that points mapStyle at a URL inherits this text, so it must render as text plus a bare link. Used by e2e/attribution-sanitize.spec.ts.

basemap-src.attribution: BASEMAP ATTRIB basemap link
